question: Does the identity-safe Ward-spend surface naturally expose the frozen producer, research consumer and same-turn payable Ward often enough across the current policy repertoire to justify the smallest CRN endpoint panel?

hypotheses.H0: Neither the brace-first level nor its preregistered bulwark fallback meets the frozen producer, consumer, payable, inactive and viable support gates, or the capacity representation has an integrity fault.
hypotheses.H1: At least one producer level has at least one spend level meeting every frozen capacity and integrity gate.

claimBoundary: Natural producer, consumer and same-turn payable-Ward capacity plus exact off/on path, policy and RNG identity only. No payoff magnitude, causal endpoint, package, candidate, detector, product, protected-seed, #421 acceptance or #108 P9 claim.

directGate.authority: Capacity only; no endpoint or candidate claim.

sharedOff.surface: The same research card is in the common pool, but no Ward source may create credit.

brace.surface: Only exact realised Ward from unchanged current-main brace may create or replace credit.

bulwark.surface: Only exact realised Ward from unchanged current-main bulwark may create or replace credit; this arm runs only after valid brace capacity futility.

factorDefinitions.payoff: Fixed absent. Payability is derived from exact source credit and current Ward; no Ward is spent and no damage operation executes.

design.type: Mechanism-blocked, common-random-number natural-capacity census with one shared off arm and a preregistered producer fallback.
fallbackMatrix: bulwark observation compared with the same shared off rows
design.fallbackRule: Run the bulwark arm only when brace has zero feasible spend levels and zero integrity faults.
design.sharedAnchors: All arms use the same content projection, root-252206084 policy index, simulation seed, Duskblade Vow-5 baseline, acquisition, draw, energy, play policy, estimator and stopping rule.
design.noCartesianSpend: Spend 4 and 8 are derived from the same opportunity telemetry; no duplicate simulator rows are spent on aliased consumer-off levels.
design.factorIsolation: Only the configured producer observation changes. Consumer effect is fixed off; Scoreline, Afterimage and every other closed package remain absent and off.
design.aliasStructure: After removing wardSpend-prefixed private telemetry, every enabled row must equal its shared off row exactly, including policy snapshot, outcome, fights, deck, stats and RNG.
design.firstLook: Brace is evaluated once on all 512 initial rows. Bulwark, if triggered, is evaluated once on 256 additional rows. There is no row, floor, cohort or analyser change.

cohort.policyIdentity: Exact tools/balance_policy.gd SHA-256 8eeeb1d3289bbab7fb033e6f175b9d2adcbb2944292c097ad09f79419e162026 plus root and index.
cohort.identityDerivation: Policy root and four seeds use 100000000 plus the first four SHA-256 bytes modulo 2047483648 of issue421|5466728774|ward-spend-v3-capacity|policy-root or seed-N.
cohort.freshness: The five identities are unique, absent from predecessor protocols and the append-only ledger, and outside protected range 3000-5399.

estimands.producerExposure: Policies with positive exact producer events in at least two of four matched seeds.
estimands.consumerExposure: Policies that naturally acquire, draw and play the pooled research consumer in at least two of four matched seeds; exact play count must equal opportunity count.
estimands.payable4: Policies with source credit and current Ward both at least 4 in at least two matched seeds.
estimands.payable8: Policies with source credit and current Ward both at least 8 in at least two matched seeds.
estimands.exactInactive: Policies with zero payable events for the spend level across all four matched seeds.
estimands.viable: Policies with payable events in at least two seeds whose matched whole run does not stall or error.
estimands.identity: Exact off/enabled equality after removing wardSpend-prefixed telemetry, plus zero spend/payoff events and exact policy/RNG identity.
estimands.notEstimated: Payoff effect, quality effect, functional separation, reachability beyond this normal acquisition path, held-out replication, detector, RC, product or P9.

gates.selectedSpendRule: Retain every spend level meeting all gates. Do not select by an endpoint because no endpoint runs here.

decisionRules.success: The exact engine, source, generated cache, direct evidence, policy identities and ledger match; capacity scripts parse; at least one producer and spend level meets every frozen support and integrity gate; all completed observations append atomically.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only the feasible producer and spend levels for one separately preregistered smallest sufficient CRN causal panel.
decisionRules.futility: A source, cache, parse, identity, path, policy, RNG, telemetry, reliability or ledger fault occurs, or brace and its conditional bulwark fallback both miss every spend-level support gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close this exact Ward-spend family without threshold, card, producer, payoff, cohort, policy, method, import, cache or rerun rescue, then continue inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A required process, complete reached-stage output or atomic ledger receipt is unavailable, or the complete decision exceeds 240 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record the result at cap without rerun, extra row, replacement cohort, endpoint inference or protected seeds.
